question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Walden, Bob gets Hamlet, Claire gets Ivanhoe, Dave gets The Trial, Eve gets Middlemarch, Fred gets Persuasion, and Gertrude gets Jane Eyre.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Dave and Eve swap books. Then, Dave and Eve swap books. Then, Claire and Bob swap books. Then, Bob and Claire swap books. Then, Eve and Fred swap books. Then, Eve and Dave swap books. Finally, Fred and Gertrude swap books. At the end of the semester, Dave has
Options:
(A) Walden
(B) Hamlet
(C) Ivanhoe
(D) The Trial
(E) Middlemarch
(F) Persuasion
(G) Jane Eyre
solution:
Each row lists the books held by Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude, in that order.
Initial: Walden | Hamlet | Ivanhoe | The Trial | Middlemarch | Persuasion | Jane Eyre
1. Dave–Eve: Walden | Hamlet | Ivanhoe | Middlemarch | The Trial | Persuasion | Jane Eyre
2. Dave–Eve: Walden | Hamlet | Ivanhoe | The Trial | Middlemarch | Persuasion | Jane Eyre
3. Claire–Bob: Walden | Ivanhoe | Hamlet | The Trial | Middlemarch | Persuasion | Jane Eyre
4. Bob–Claire: Walden | Hamlet | Ivanhoe | The Trial | Middlemarch | Persuasion | Jane Eyre
5. Eve–Fred: Walden | Hamlet | Ivanhoe | The Trial | Persuasion | Middlemarch | Jane Eyre
6. Eve–Dave: Walden | Hamlet | Ivanhoe | Persuasion | The Trial | Middlemarch | Jane Eyre
7. Fred–Gertrude: Walden | Hamlet | Ivanhoe | Persuasion | The Trial | Jane Eyre | Middlemarch
Dave has Persuasion, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
